messages.text:
At 12¢ or under, the KBOX costs you about $24 a month to run, against $800 for the unit — 22 TH/s of real block draws, every ten minutes, for years.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?

For a first miner, the 40T is the better buy: $799 against the KBOX's $800, but 40 TH/s instead of 22 — nearly double the block draws. Power runs about $47 a month at 10¢, versus $24 for the KBOX. It ships November 21.

Where would it sit — desk or garage?

Garage is ideal — the 40T is about 50 dB in Eco, so noise and heat won't bother anyone out there, and you can run it in Turbo at 50 TH/s if you want the extra draws.

Want me to put one in the cart?
